_source: Constructed: tool description = Cell A's constructed rich description (unchanged). Param docs sparsified (constructed minimal one-liners, not historical text) for match_mode/follow_depth/impl_only/import_lookup/def_use/summary/git_ref. path/symbol/cursor/page_size/max_depth unchanged (not part of the rich/sparse axis).

tool.name: analyze_symbol
tool.description: Build call graph for a named function or method across all files in a directory to trace a specific function's usage. Returns direct callers and callees. Default symbol lookup is case-sensitive exact-match (match_mode=exact); myFunc and myfunc are different symbols. If exact match fails, retry with match_mode=insensitive for a case-insensitive search. To list candidates matching a prefix, use match_mode=prefix. To find symbols containing a substring, use match_mode=contains. When prefix or contains matches multiple symbols, an error is returned listing all candidates so you can refine to a single match. follow_depth warning: each increment can multiply output size exponentially; use follow_depth=1 for production use; follow_depth=2+ only for targeted deep dives; hard cap of 3, values above 3 return INVALID_PARAMS. impl_only=true: restrict callers to only those from 'impl Trait for Type' blocks (Rust only); returns INVALID_PARAMS for non-Rust directories; emits a FILTER header showing how many callers were retained. import_lookup=true: instead of a call graph, find all files importing the module path given in symbol (e.g., std::collections); requires a non-empty symbol; mutually exclusive with def_use and normal call-graph lookup — when set, follow_depth, impl_only, and match_mode are ignored. def_use=true: instead of a call graph, extract write/read sites for the symbol; mutually exclusive with import_lookup. summary and cursor are mutually exclusive; passing both returns an error. git_ref restricts analysis to files changed relative to a git ref. Example queries: Find all callers of the parse_config function; Trace the call chain for MyClass.process_request up to 2 levels deep; Show only trait impl callers of the write method; Find every file that imports std::collections; Show all write/read sites for the API_KEY constant.

path.description: Directory path to search for the symbol

symbol.description: Symbol name to build call graph for (function or method). Example: `parse_config` finds all callers and callees of that function.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory traversal depth. Unset means unlimited. Use 2-3 for large monorepos.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor field. Pass unchanged to retrieve the next page. Omit on the first call.

page_size.description: Files per page for pagination (default: 100). Reduce below 100 to limit response size; increase above 100 to reduce round trips.

impl_only.description: Restrict callers to Rust trait impl blocks.

import_lookup.description: Find files importing a module path.

git_ref.description: Restrict to files changed since this git ref.

def_use.description: Extract write/read sites for the symbol.
